title: Glowing magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow behind lens -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='32' fill='#1a3a4a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <rect x='60' y='58' width='10' height='34' rx='5' fill='#ff8c42' transform='rotate(-45 65 75)'/>
  <rect x='62' y='60' width='6' height='30' rx='3' fill='#ffb347' transform='rotate(-45 65 75)'/>
  <!-- Handle end cap -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='84' r='7' fill='#ff6b1a'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='84' r='4' fill='#ffcc66'/>
  <!-- Lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='26' fill='#2a5a7a'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='26' fill='none' stroke='#66d9ff' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#44aadd' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Lens glass -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='21' fill='#1a4466'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='21' fill='#1e5a88' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Lens shine -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='28' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#99eeff' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-30 32 28)'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='27' r='3' fill='#ccffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Glow rays from lens -->
  <line x1='40' y1='4' x2='40' y2='10' stroke='#66eeff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='14' x2='22' y2='18' stroke='#66eeff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='14' x2='58' y2='18' stroke='#66eeff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='10' y1='36' x2='16' y2='36' stroke='#66eeff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='36' x2='64' y2='36' stroke='#66eeff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Lens inner glow -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='14' fill='#2a88bb' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='7' fill='#55ccff' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- Cute face on lens -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#88ffff'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#88ffff'/>
  <path d='M35 41 Q40 46 45 41' fill='none' stroke='#88ffff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='40' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff88cc' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff88cc' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
